equivalent: the budget is the number of aliases in the module, which already exceeds the longest chain that leads anywhere, so stopping at -1 instead of 0 takes one more step and reaches nothing the original could not; a cycle still ends when the budget runs out.

honest-design/src/honest_design/reach.py: non-terminating: without the add, `key in seen` is never true, so a declared cycle (run -> emit -> run, the looping case in laws_hd._probe_reach) pushes the same functions onto the frontier forever. Verified by running reach() with the line removed on that module: still looping after 10s, where the real code answers in microseconds. The other job of `seen`, walking a shared callee once, is pinned by the diamond case in the same probe, but that case cannot report while the cycle case never returns.
